Class NominalValue

java.lang.Object
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.Symbol
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.NominalValue
All Implemented Interfaces:
Commented, Value, Comparable<Value>
public class NominalValue extends Symbol implements Value
A nominal value is a story graph symbol that can be assigned to a Fluent in a node's state.

New nominal values should be created in a story graph using the ValueList.add(String) method.

    • toBoolean

      public boolean toBoolean()
      Converts this value to a Java Boolean.

      If this value's name, when converted to upper case, is "T" or "TRUE", this method returns Boolean true. If this value's name, when converted to upper case, is "F" or "FALSE", this method returns Boolean false. Otherwise, this method throws an exception.
